premise_match.title: Local factoriality identifies Picard and divisor classes
premise_match.statement: For a locally Noetherian integral scheme, local factoriality is equivalent to normality and surjectivity of Pic to Cl; under these conditions the map is an isomorphism.
prerequisites: Local rings UFD for the forward direction used here
premise_match.application: X and A1 times X meet the forward hypotheses. Normality alone must not be substituted for local factoriality.

premise_match.title: Principal ideal height bound
premise_match.statement: In a Noetherian ring a prime minimal over a principal ideal has height at most one. The second part excludes intermediate primes for a minimal principal extension of a prime.
premise_match.application: For the nonzero c in the integral domain C used in the divisor argument, a minimal prime over c cannot be the zero prime, so the bound gives height exactly one.
